notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date or design in any source; the 1917 patrol summary (bare site, no structures) conflicts with the register's 'used circa 1917' and the 1920 newspaper's 'Lookout Mountain tower', and the conflict is not resolved, so the story gives no build year. The register records no coordinates; the brief's 41.6979, -78.1484 is about 0.1 km from the MountainZone summit point (41.6981, -78.1470), so it was not changed. No source describes the site today; access is unknown and no access facts are recorded. Nothing in the record was found wrong, so no corrections are proposed.
